_note: Staging catalogue for the clinician schedule slice. Not loaded by lib/i18n/index.ts yet (that file is owned elsewhere) — merge the `opesDoctor` object into lib/i18n/locales/en.json and delete this file. Keys are the `error_code` values returned by the server (app/Http/Controllers/Api/Mobile/MobileDoctorScheduleController.php, wording in lang/en/doctor_schedule.php). They exist client-side because SetLocale is registered on the `web` middleware group only, so /api/* refusals ignore Accept-Language and always answer in the application default locale; `error_code` is what lets the phone say it in the clinician's language. Key set MUST stay 1:1 with doctor_schedule.fr.json.
